lane.instructions: Which worker lane should handle this video-production task?

criteria.tsx_scene: write or fix a React/Remotion scene component, its animation, or the tooling code around it
criteria.figcraft_layout: move, space or resize elements in an existing scene layout
criteria.svg_asset: draw an icon, diagram or other vector asset
criteria.on_screen_text: change the words, captions or labels shown on screen
criteria.audit_sweep: check or verify many scenes, files or frames for consistency
criteria.research: answer fact-check or background questions from sources

tier.instructions: How much judgment does this task need?
criteria: mechanical: a small exact edit with no design choice
standard: a normal implementation or fix
judgment: architecture, calibration, or a wide audit

session_action.instructions: Should a live session continue this, or a new one start?

criteria.resume_builder: follow-up fix on a scene whose builder session is live
criteria.resume_checker: a check for the persistent checker session
criteria.spawn: new work for a new session

context_source.instructions: Which reference material does the worker need?

criteria.none: no book content; code or tooling only
